# Human Hand Motion and Manipulation Video Modeling

[Home](../../../README.md) · [All categories](../../README.md) · [简体中文](human-hand-modeling_cn.md)

Manipulation Action Models → Multi-Fingered Dexterous Hand Manipulation Research → Human Hand Motion and Manipulation Video Modeling

Supporting research on human hand/camera trajectories and manipulation videos: reconstruction, prediction and instruction-conditioned generation. Distinguish human representations and robot retargeting demonstrations from directly learned closed-loop robot control.

Predict: initial image + specified trajectories → future video. Plan: initial image + instruction + optional goal image → trajectories and future video.<br>**Method:** Couple video/action streams in a Wan backbone using shared base weights and bidirectional attention, training with randomized modality visibility. Actions represent MANO human hands and camera motion; robot execution requires retargeting.<br>**Evaluation scope:** Reconstruction and video prediction evaluated on EgoDex, ARCTIC, HOT3D and EgoLive; Plan uses human/VLM video ratings. Robot evidence comprises two retargeted open-loop experiments, without online feedback correction; video ratings are not robot task success rates. | arXiv v1 / 2026 | [Paper](https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.22363v1) · [Project](https://p3-wam.pages.dev/) | Initial reading<br>2026-10-23 |
